integrity: The proof first shows that every leading Schur complement remains inside the original spectral interval, then solves the exact two-dimensional extremal problem for an off-diagonal-to-diagonal ratio. A closed-form two-dimensional family attains the multiplier bound for every condition number. The standalone checker verifies the algebraic boundary and an exact rational forced-swap witness; finite checks do not replace the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic theorem for real SPD matrices and classical scalar partial pivoting. The strict no-swap statement is tie-policy independent below the frontier; equality permits a tie. Floating-point comparison errors, scaling, sparse permutations, threshold pivoting, rook pivoting, complete pivoting, and block pivoting are outside scope.
title: Sharp condition-number frontier for row swaps in partially pivoted Gaussian elimination
